programme.title: Marcus Level
programme.desc: Pour gagner un fragment de miroir, Marcus doit dresser et chevaucher un tout petit poney, ce qui le contrarie. Vipkrad a capturé les Coco-singes, et seul ce fragment peut les sauver. Sur l'Ile aux galions hantée de squelettes, Marcus perd ses lunettes. Guidé par ses amis, il affronte sa peur et avance plus fort.

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Lulu se retrouve responsable de la classe. Enseigner et avoir de l'autorité sans être un tyran, ce n'est pas facile...Les amis se fâchent suite à une dispute au sujet de leurs petits défauts. Du coup, le match de hockey qu'ils devaient disputer est annulé. Lulu va tenter de réconcilier tout le monde et de faire accepter à chacun ses petits défauts... y compris à elle !

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Grabouillon provoque une marée noire à la plage, Cunégonde teste une machine à laver solaire qui l'essore. Il se prend pour roi grâce à des peintures rupestres, puis enlève un drapeau, mettant Gladys et Pétunia en danger en mer. Enfin, il nourrit des larves de moustiques avec des graines de poivre, causant une réaction piquante.

programme.title: Ovni
programme.desc: Enlevé par Robin des Bois, pourchassé dans un opéra, interrompu par Elvis alors qu'il tente de contacter un extra-terrestre, Coda finit sur un tremplin de ski, persuadé de pouvoir rentrer chez lui. Mais entre tirs à l'arc douteux, rats agressifs, ondes saturées et vols ratés, son retour tourne, une fois de plus, à la catastrophe !

programme.title: Marcus Level
programme.desc: Vipkrad détruit une partie de la forêt d'Espictroll, Marcus promet de le punir. En infiltrant son camp, Marcus trouve une armure qui le rend plus fort mais aussi impulsif, inquiétant Ephi. Séparé de ses amis et prisonnier sur le vaisseau de Vipkrad, Marcus doit s'évader, sauver ses amis et empêcher la destruction de la Vallée des 7 Tours de Lumière.

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Qu'est-ce que le bonheur ?Blaise est bizarre et toujours collé à la maîtresse, ce qui n'échappe pas aux copains, bientOt pris d'un doute affreux : et s'il essayait de devenir le chouchou ?

programme.title: Petites Poules
programme.desc: Gargantua arrive au poulailler, prêt à manger des poules. Pour l'arrêter, on lui sert un festin végétarien. Pendant ce temps, Carmélito et Coquenpâte sont kidnappés par les rats. Gargantua les libère. Plus tard, Nicolas Flamel emprunte la marmite de Pédro pour faire de l'or, mais ça explose. La marmite brille pourtant au soleil.

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Nos amis partent camper, et Gladys avec son matériel high-tech séduit tout le monde. Grabouillon termine sa boîte de croquettes et, pour éviter de nettoyer la plage, cherche des astuces. Attiré par une abeille près de la ruche de Pétunia, il risque de se faire piquer. Fasciné par le couteau suisse de Basile, il le vole en forêt, mais se met rapidement en difficulté.

programme.title: Marcus Level
programme.desc: Aux championnats des Sept Tours de Lumières, Marcus rêve de gagner la coupe remise par son idole, Copacabanana. Ephi et Gratrok ne comprennent pas son obsession. Ensuite, Marcus affronte Cusmar, un fantôme lié à un record triché. Effondré, il enseigne la triche à ses amis… et si c'était la clé pour gagner ?

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Blaise est amoureux de Froufrou. Lulu et Rien-Ne-Sert décident, bien malgré Blaise, de jouer les Cyrano auprès de la petite chouette.Lulu veut prévenir tous ses amis que le premier perce-neige est arrivé. Mais le message, passant d'un ami à l'autre, est déformé au fur et à mesure de sa transmission. Lorsqu'il arrive à Rien-Ne-Sert, il n'a plus rien à voir avec l'original.

programme.title: Sherlock Yack
programme.desc: Après une partie d'échecs contre Olonbec, Sherlock est retrouvé assommé. Le coupable est-il un cochon d'Inde, un zébu blanc ou un okapi ? Par ailleurs, Sherlock cache son addiction aux jeux vidéo, mais Hermine a compris. Le tapir perd son gri-gri porte-bonheur, volé par un invité : kangourou, croco ou pélican ? Sherlock, superstitieux ? Pas sûr…

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: La taupe offre un jeu vidéo à Grabouillon pour qu'il se calme, mais il devient obsédé. En peignant, Grabouillon salit le camp, alors il fait nettoyer Tatouwak à sa place, mauvaise idée ! Bagou se moque avec sa raquette, Grabouillon apprend des acrobaties pour la récupérer. Pour éviter l'Aloe Vera, il simule une allergie avec l'aide de Bagou.

programme.title: Sherlock Yack
programme.desc: La Tortue, croupière au Babouin's, est piégée dans sa carapace, cimentée ! Trois clients perdants sont suspects. Sherlock enquête, tout en tentant de décrypter un message étrange reçu dans un gâteau. Plus tard, le Gorille videur est assommé. Lion ou Oiseau de paradis ? Sherlock, toujours refusé aux soirées, va devoir apprendre à être plus cool...

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Ni-Oui se souvient de son premier jour d'école et de sa rencontre avec tous les amis. Ce ne fut pas facile…Lulu et les copains préparent un ballet pour le spectacle de fin d'années mais RNS a honte de danser...

programme.title: Chenilles et métamorphoses
programme.desc: Observez les petites bêtes de la prairie se métamorphoser de façon surprenante : Maya apprend que le changement peut être magnifique.

programme.title: Contes de la nuit
programme.desc: Quand le soleil se couche, la prairie continue de bourdonner : découvrez les aventures nocturnes les plus magiques de Maya.

programme.title: Fleurs et nature
programme.desc: Fleurs rares, jardins secrets et merveilles de la nature : Maya explore la prairie en pleine floraison.

programme.title: Le premier envol de Maya
programme.desc: Retournez tout au début : Maya naît, apprend à voler et tombe amoureuse de la prairie qu'elle appelle désormais sa maison.

programme.title: Amis pour la vie
programme.desc: Maya et Willy prouvent que les plus belles aventures sont celles que l'on partage avec son meilleur ami.

programme.title: Pagaille dans la prairie
programme.desc: Coquilles cassées et boules en fuite : suivez Maya et ses amis quand les jeux du quotidien tournent à la joyeuse pagaille.

programme.title: Drôles d'abeilles

programme.title: Trop jeune pour ça
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie sont invités à assister à un combat d'arts martiaux pour filmer en coulisses. Mais Spencer et Mrs Benson refusent de les laisser y aller.

programme.title: Que le meilleur chante
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie demandent aux fans d'iCarly de voter pour David Archuleta afin qu'il remporte AMERICA SINGS. Mais ils se sentent mal à l'aise par rapport au deuxième et l'aident à créer son clip.

programme.title: Sam devient gentille
programme.desc: Sam craque sur un garçon qui n'aime que les filles très féminines. Carly aide alors Sam à se relooker.

programme.title: Carly et Clyde
programme.desc: Griffin, le nouveau voisin de Carly et Spencer, vole la moto que Carly a offert à Spencer.

programme.title: La meilleure amie
programme.desc: Missy Robinson, l'ancienne amie de Carly, revient dans sa vie. Sam se sent alors mise de côté.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie perdent l'URL iCarly au profit de Nevel. Ce dernier demande à Carly de l'embrasser en échange de l'URL. De son côté, Spencer s'amuse avec les deux cent oreillers qu'il a commandés par erreur...

programme.title: Le combat
programme.desc: Carly et la championne d'arts martiaux Shelby Marx acceptent de se livrer à une démonstration de combat pour le compte d'une oeuvre de charité.

programme.title: Le combat
programme.desc: Carly et la championne d'arts martiaux Shelby Marx acceptent de se livrer à une démonstration de combat pour le compte d'une oeuvre de charité.

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie présentent les iCarly Awards. Ils récompensent en direct les auteurs des meilleurs contenus envoyés sur le site.

programme.title: Mélanie
programme.desc: Surprise, surprise ! Sam a une sœur jumelle appelée Mélanie. Et encore plus surprenant, elle est beaucoup plus féminine que Sam, et craque pour Freddie, qui la prend pour Sam déguisée.

programme.title: Carly et Clyde
programme.desc: Griffin, le nouveau voisin de Carly et Spencer, vole la moto que Carly a offert à Spencer.

programme.title: contre Dingo Channel
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie découvrent qu'une émission de télé sur Dingo Channel plagie des contenus d'iCarly. Ils décident alors de se rendre à Los Angeles pour confronter les auteurs de l'émission.

programme.title: Laveu
programme.desc: Sous l'influence d'un gaz hilarant chez le dentiste, Sam parle à Carly de son baiser avec Freddie.

programme.title: Le concours de cuisine
programme.desc: Carly et Sam utilisent la recette de taco aux spaghettis de Spencer à l'occasion d'un concours télévisé avec un grand Chef.

programme.title: Le principal Franklin
programme.desc: Après que le Principal Franklin se soit fait renvoyer accidentellement à cause de Carly, Sam et Freddie, Mme Briggs et Mr Howard prennent le contrôle de l'école et instaurent des règles sévères ainsi qu'un code vestimentaire.

programme.title: Far away: les soldats de l'espoir
programme.desc: Inspiré d'une histoire vraie. Jun Shik travaille à la ferme du grand-père de Tatsuo alors que la Corée est colonisée par le Japon, mais il rêve de participer aux Jeux olympiques de Tokyo en tant que coureur de marathon. Tatsuo vise également à devenir marathonien, ce qui crée une rivalité entre eux. Mais la guerre éclate et ils sont tous deux forcés de s'enrôler dans l'armée. Tatsuo devient chef de la défense dans l'unité de Jun Shik et élabore un plan qui échoue. Jun Shik et Tatsuo sont capturés par les Soviétiques. Ils s'échappent mais sont rapidement capturés par les Allemands et forcés de se séparer. En 1944, ils se retrouvent sur les plages de Normandie.

programme.title: Every Last One of Them
programme.desc: Un homme est à la recherche de sa fille disparue, mais sa recherche révèle un complot plus vaste impliquant un gros accord capitaliste qui fait dérailler Chinatown sur les droits de l'eau.

programme.title: Doomsday Device
programme.desc: Deux agents du FBI qui tentent d'arrêter plusieurs escrocs découvrent qu'ils détiennent un ancien artefact japonais d'une puissance énorme. Ils tentent alors d'empêcher les escrocs de livrer la pierre au cerveau du crime, qui est un riche homme d'affaires.

programme.title: Battle Drone
programme.desc: 6 mercenaires sont engagés par la CIA pour enlever l'héritier d'une république et éliminer un marchand d'armes à Moscou et reçoivent une autre mission à Tchernobyl où la trahison les attend.

programme.title: 12 Chiens pour Noël
programme.desc: Pendant la Grande Dépression, une jeune fille organise une pièce de Noël mettant en vedette des chiens pour convaincre sa ville d'abandonner l'interdiction des chiens.

programme.title: Un nouveau départ pour Noël
programme.desc: Laissant de côté sa vie glamour à Hollywood, Evie Lee retourne dans sa petite ville natale, dans la ferme de sapins de Noël autrefois prospère de sa famille pour assister aux funérailles de son père. Elle doit à présent reprendre la gestion de la ferme, au grand désarroi de son frère cadet.

programme.title: Magie de noël
programme.desc: Après un accident de voiture, une femme se réveille à Central Park avec un ange, qui lui donne une chance de gagner l'entrée au paradis.Le film est une histoire de découverte et le véritable esprit de Noël.

programme.title: Un Noël en Alaska
programme.desc: Lorsque la femme d'affaires Jennifer apprend que ses parents seront absents pendant les vacances de fin d'année, elle décide de quitter sa vie animée de citadine à San Francisco, pour visiter l'auberge de sa grand-mère en Alaska dont elle a héritée.

programme.title: Trigger Point
programme.desc: Nicolas Shaw fait partie d'une équipe d'élite secrète qui élimine les pires tueurs du monde. Après avoir été accusé de l'assassinat d'un membre de son équipe, il doit laver son nom et empêcher le meurtre des autres agents...

programme.title: Morgue
programme.desc: Diego Martinez obtient un job d'agent de sécurité de nuit dans un hôpital. Lors de sa première ronde dans l'hôpital présumé vide, il entend des bruits étranges. Mais quand il veut sortir, il réalise qu'il est enfermé dans la morgue et les phénomènes inquiétants ne font que se multiplier...

programme.title: Diamonds War
programme.desc: Un ancien combattant de MMA et ses frères doivent sauver leur famille kidnappée d'un dangereux syndicat du crime après le vol de 50 millions de dollars de diamants issus de trafics.

programme.title: Immortelle
programme.desc: Une vampire tente de séduire un peintre pour qu'il accepte de faire son portrait afin qu'elle puisse se voir pour la première fois.

programme.title: The Survivalist
programme.desc: Après qu'un virus mortel a décimé l'humanité, un ancien agent du FBI protège une jeune femme naturellement immunisée. Traquée par un gang dirigé par un dangereux psychopathe qui veut exploiter son immunité, elle représente peut-être le dernier espoir de sauver le monde.

programme.title: Vertige
programme.desc: Dans notre monde urbain, le système jette les hommes à terre dans l'indifférence. Mais vue sous un angle nouveau, la ville devient un espace à redécouvrir et à reconstruire.

programme.title: Yulia
programme.desc: Subitement arrachée à ses journaux, Yulia, se retrouve parachutée dans une pièce sans issue avec cinq manettes fixées au mur. En les actionnant, elle déclenche une série d'événements absurdes qui la conduiront à trouver l'âme soeur.

programme.title: Moonkup
programme.desc: Comme toutes les femmes d'Europe, Eva donne son sang pour faire durer la paix avec les vampires. Elle est la fille bâtarde du puissant Monsieur Pire qui a fait fortune dans le transport de l'hémoglobine. Quand Monsieur Pire décide de marier sa fille légitime au fils d'un puissant vampire, Éva profite de la noce pour rendre justice aux femmes, quitte à mettre en danger la paix.

programme.title: La vie sauvage
programme.desc: Arnaud et Nora, trentenaires en vacances, terminent leur weekend en province par une visite d'un parc safari. Tout excités à l'idée de découvrir une faune insolite, ils se comportent comme des enfants et se prennent pour des animaux, oubliant un instant que ces derniers sont en liberté… Entre sexe, folie et barbapapa, le couple ne sortira pas indemne de cette expédition.

programme.title: La Pureté de l'enfance
programme.desc: L'écoute d'une cassette retrouvée transporte la bédéiste Zviane vers son enfance. Basé sur un enregistrement réel, ce film hilarant traduit avec un style ludique l'imaginaire des enfants. Une fenêtre sur le quotidien signée Chroniques du 9e art.

programme.title: Nice
programme.desc: Martial, 17 ans, a fugué à Nice pour venir voir sa mère, chanteuse à la vie chaotique. Près de la maison de celle-ci, il rencontre trois femmes : une employée des Assédic, une ancienne camarade de classe et la propriétaire des lieux. Trois fragments d'éducation sentimentale, trois secrets, trois chansons.

programme.title: Tapette
programme.desc: Alors qu'il est sur le point de s'installer avec sa petite amie, Michel a une montée d'angoisse. Pour éviter de s'engager, il va se persuader qu'il est homosexuel.

programme.title: Journée d'appel
programme.desc: Une bande de jeunes banlieusards passe leur journée d'appel à la caserne de Versailles. L'un d'eux, Chris, arrivé trop tard à la caserne, veut rentrer au quartier, mais Momo, une baltringue de leur cité, le persuade de passer la journée au château de Versailles.

programme.title: Obras
programme.desc: Obras propose, en un unique plan-séquence, un voyage dans le temps et l'espace, une déambulation poétique, graphique et sonore qui traduit visuellement les mutations urbaines, sauvages et irréversibles, à travers la destruction / reconstruction de Barcelone.

programme.title: Ghost Cell
programme.desc: À la fois film scientifique, documentaire et balade onirique, Ghost Cell est une plongée en relief au coeur des entrailles d'un Paris organique vu comme une cellule au travers d'un microscope virtuel.

programme.title: Eclipse
programme.desc: Sur une planète éloignée, deux scientifiques venus analyser le terrain pour ses particularités magnétiques sont confrontés à un phénomène extraordinaire lié à une éclipse de lune.

programme.title: Grounded
programme.desc: Un jeune soldat sans expérience est envoyé à un poste de surveillance, au beau milieu d'un désert.

programme.title: Aquabike
programme.desc: Traumatisée par un poisson, Sophie n'a jamais remis les pieds dans l'eau depuis ses 15 ans. Aujourd'hui elle en a 35 et sa copine Anaïs a décidé de l'emmener voir Aquaman, un gourou-guérisseur aux méthodes radicales.

programme.title: Oripeaux
programme.desc: Dans un village isolé, une petite fille se lie d'amitié avec une meute de coyotes. Les villageois mettent brutalement fin à cette relation sans se douter du soulèvement qui les guette

programme.title: Les aoutiens
programme.desc: André est mis à la porte par sa copine un matin d'août avec pour seul bagage son immense plant de cannabis. Impossible de traverser seul Paris avec ce fardeau illégal et encombrant. André demande donc l'aide de Joël, un ami d'enfance frivole.

programme.title: La bête
programme.desc: Une jeune femme se caresse. De ses poils naît une bête démesurée, dont le corps épouse et violente le sien.

programme.title: Zoo
programme.desc: Des menstruations de leurs filles à la naissance de leur chien, tout est sous contrôle dans la vie d'Emmanuelle et Olivier Teziev. Mais ce matin Léa, leur fille cadette, n'est pas descendue déjeuner. Sur son lit, à sa place, les Teziev et Emilie, leur aînée, découvrent avec horreur un monstrueux cocon. Progressivement le chaos s'installe.

programme.title: Argile
programme.desc: Alex pose. Une vieille dame sculpte. Une situation normale... si la dame en question n'était pas une aveugle et n'avait pour « voir » que ses mains. Des mains ridées qu'elle pose sur le corps nu de son jeune modèle. Alex va connaître une séance de pose inhabituelle.

programme.title: Fard
programme.desc: Dans un futur proche, le monde semble fonctionner de façon efficace et contrôlée...

programme.title: A/K
programme.desc: A/K c'est l'histoire de Kim et Anouk qui attendent un bus qui n'arrivera jamais. Pour passer le temps, elles inventent une histoire, celle de Ted « le flic cowboy » et de « Joe le solitaire ». Alors que leurs aventures s'enchaînent au rythme de la folle imagination des deux filles, la voiture de police de Ted s'arrête devant leur abris bus.

programme.title: La peur du vide
programme.desc: Simone est une vieille dame isolée, dont le quotidien est rythmé par un étrange tas de détritus, si imposant dans son petit appartement qu'il l'empêche de vivre normalement. Un jour, Simone se risque à y toucher...

programme.title: Chienne d'histoire
programme.desc: Constantinople 1910. Trop de chiens errants dans les rues de la ville. Le gouvernement en place cherche le moyen de s'en débarrasser avant de décider de déporter 30 000 chiens sur une île déserte au large de la ville.

programme.title: Faites l'amour !
programme.desc: Vincent et Margot, deux acteurs, doivent tourner une scène d'amour. Mais la frontière entre le jeu et la réalité est mince, au moins autant que celle entre l'amour et la haine. À eux d'en faire l'expérience.

programme.title: The Women
programme.desc: Mary est mariée à Stephen Haines, un homme d'affaires new-yorkais. Fidèle à son époux et mère d'une fillette, elle est entourée d'"amies", dont Sylvia Fowler, la comtesse DeLave, et Miriam Aarons, qui savent quelque chose qu'elle ignore : son mari la trompe avec Crystal Allen, une vendeuse arriviste...

programme.title: Les Nouveaux Tricheurs
programme.desc: Ils ont entre seize et dix-neuf ans. Il y a Franck, l'artiste, Betti, la vraie copine qui comprend tout, Karl, le passionné d'informatique et Marc, qui a un charme fou. Ils sont tous jeunes, animés par un vrai désir de réussite. Ils croient tous au bonheur et jouent avec l'amour tout aussi bien qu'avec le feu, et cela avec beaucoup d'innocence et autant de passion.

programme.title: Point De Chute
programme.desc: Trois voyous enlèvent une jeune fille de quinze ans, Patricia, pour obtenir de son père le versement d'une rançon. Ils la séquestrent dans une cabane perdue au bord de la mer et la battent. Seul Eddie, un jeune voyou, gardien de la jeune fille, s'insurge contre ces méthodes. A travers un fait divers tragique, le portrait de deux adolescents dans un climat d'angoisse et de violence.

programme.title: Dangerous Intentions
programme.desc: Depuis des années, Beth Williamson supporte le comportement extrêmement violent de son mari Tim. Elle cache la terrible réalité à sa famille ainsi qu'à ses amis, mais surtout à sa fille Laurie. Un jour, elle décide de prendre sa vie en main et retourne chez sa mère. Emprisonné puis relâché, Tim a juré de se venger. Entre temps Beth rencontre Kaye, elle aussi victime de violence conjugale. Les deux amies prennent une maison ensemble en espérant que la vie va enfin commencer pour elles et leurs enfants...

programme.title: Le Sourire De Mona Lisa
programme.desc: Julia Roberts, lauréate d'un Oscar, brille dans ce film au casting étourdissant : Kirsten Dunst, Julia Stiles, Maggie Gyllenhaal et l'oscarisée Marcia Gay Harden.

programme.title: Sahara (2005)
programme.desc: Pour Dirk Pitt, explorateur, scientifique et aventurier, découvrir cette pièce de légende n'était que le premier pas vers l'aventure la plus risquée de sa vie et une incroyable légende historique...

programme.title: Les 3 crimes de West Memphis
programme.desc: En 1993, trois enfants sont retrouvés mort à West Memphis, ville de l'Arkansas. Accusés d'être des satanistes adorateurs de musique Heavy Metal, trois adolescents ont été condamnés l'année suivante à perpétuité pour ce triple meurtre.

programme.title: Tu m'épouseras
programme.desc: Emerson tue son ex et harcèle Carmen, son organisatrice de mariage, allant jusqu'à enlever sa fille.

programme.title: Held Up
programme.desc: Ce qui devait être une escapade romantique se transforme en une série de déboires désopilants. La femme de Michael l'abandonne dans le désert, où il se fait voler sa voiture par un adolescent et se retrouve pris en otage lors du braquage d'un magasin.

programme.title: How to Be a Latin Lover
programme.desc: Eugenio Derbez (NI REPRIS, NI ÉCHANGÉ) est l'acteur principal de cette comédie furieusement drôle au casting de rêve ! Lorsque Maximo, le séducteur latin vieillissant (Derbez), se fait plaquer par la femme d'âge mûr qu'il a épousée pour son argent, il emménage chez sa sœur Sara (Salma Hayek), à qui il ne parlait plus, et Hugo, son fils de dix ans.

programme.title: Le meilleur cuisinier
programme.desc: Melissa McCarthy partage l'affiche avec une troupe de génies de la comédie et un mocumentaire délicieusement espiègle sur le monde passionné et cruel de la compétition culinaire.

programme.title: Où est l'argent
programme.desc: Un jeune homme vif d'esprit des rues de South Central doit intégrer en urgence une fraternité blanche comme neige de l'Université du Sud de la Californie pour récupérer un stock d'argent volé.

programme.title: Coldwater
programme.desc: Brad est un adolescent impliqué dans plusieurs petits délits. Ses parents décident de le faire emmener de force dans le camp de redressement pour mineurs très isolé de Coldwater.

programme.title: Fat Man And Little Boy
programme.desc: Au Nouveau Mexique, le très secret Manhattan Project vise à construire la première bombe atomique, sous la direction de Robert Oppenheimer.

programme.title: Mulan, la guerrière légendaire
programme.desc: Mulan est une jeune chinoise de bonne famille. Quand son père malade est appelé sur le champ de bataille après l'invasion des Huns, la jeune fille refuse de le voir partir. Elle se fait alors passer pour un homme et devient une courageuse guerrière.

programme.title: LE 2E AMENDEMENT
programme.desc: Le Major Vic Davis, est en route pour aller chercher son fils, Shawn, à l'université. A peine arrivé, il se retrouve au milieu d'une opération terroriste de grande envergure visant la fille d'un juge de la Cour suprême.

programme.desc: Retrouvez tous les dossiers spéciaux sur le cinéma et les séries.

programme.desc: Des comics à Hollywood, l'incroyable ascension des super-héros devenus un phénomène mondial.

programme.desc: "Blockbusters 80" nous replonge dans les films d'action iconiques des années 80, symboles d'une époque.

programme.title: Une nouvelle chance (2016)
programme.desc: Un avenir de jeune chef tendait les bras à Charlie. Pourtant sa vie semble s'être suspendue, habitant avec sa mère et son beau-père et travaillant dans le cinéma de son quartier, Charlie n'a plus de motivation pour rien...

programme.title: Un secret bien gardé
programme.desc: Une jeune femme, responsable marketing, effectue son premier voyage d'affaires à Glasgow. Sur le chemin du retour, son avion traverse une zone de turbulences. Angoissée à l'idée de perdre la vie, elle livre quelques petits secrets à son voisin.

programme.title: Amour Aveugle
programme.desc: Un romancier new-yorkais est rendu aveugle par un accident de voiture qui tue sa femme. Des années plus tard, il retrouve l'envie de vivre et d'écrire lorsqu'il commence une aventure avec une femme négligée par son mari, un homme d'affaires.

programme.title: Ne serait-ce que
programme.desc: Une tragédie apprend au jeune homme d'affaires anglais Ian Wyndham à faire passer l'amour avant le travail. Il apprend enfin à s'ouvrir à sa petite amie Samantha Andrews.

programme.title: Love & Radio Star
programme.desc: Savannah est engagée pour redorer l'image du quatrième animateur radio de New York. Mais lorsqu'elle se retrouve accidentellement à l'antenne avec lui, elle devient elle-même partie intégrante de la nouvelle image de l'émission et découvre si leurs différences à l'antenne ou l'amour auront le dernier mot.

programme.title: Flirt et Passe-Passe
programme.desc: Des jumelles identiques, Alice et Lacey, sont prises l'une pour l'autre lors d'une retraite. Elles décident de jouer le jeu le temps du séjour, mais réalisent bientôt qu'elles se sont peut-être trompées sur ce dont elles avaient réellement besoin dans leur vie.

programme.title: De l'Italie avec Amore
programme.desc: Ariel Moss aperçoit ce qu'elle pense être l'homme de ses rêves dans un restaurant local. Dans sa quête pour le revoir, elle rencontre Daniel, un séduisant restaurateur, qui l'aide à comprendre que le chemin vers son cœur passe peut-être par son estomac.

programme.title: Supernova
programme.desc: Sam et Tusker s'aiment depuis 20 ans. A bord de leur vieux camping-car, ils rendent visite à leurs amis et famille et retournent sur les lieux de leur jeunesse. Depuis que Tusker est atteint d'une grave maladie, tous leurs projets ont été suspendus. Le temps est compté et être ensemble est désormais la chose la plus précieuse. Cependant, ce dernier voyage va mettre leur amour à rude épreuve.

programme.title: Une Pluie sans Fin
programme.desc: Un homme licencié d'une aciérie veut désespérément traquer un tueur en série dans une petite ville du sud de la Chine.

programme.title: Par Amour
programme.desc: Dans un cours de théâtre, l'amour sera vécu aussi fort que l'histoire de la pièce de Shakespeare.

programme.title: Ice
programme.desc: la Russie contemporaine. Nadya abandonne son rêve lorsqu'elle est hospitalisée pour une blessure.

programme.title: Opération Lidice
programme.desc: Le 27 mai 1942, à Prague, l'officier SS Reinhard Heydrich est victime d'un attentat organisé par la résistance

programme.title: Par Amour
programme.desc: Dans un cours de théâtre, l'amour sera vécu aussi fort que l'histoire de la pièce de Shakespeare.

programme.title: Coup de foudre sucré salé
programme.desc: Alison reste notoirement anonyme lorsqu'elle critique des restaurants. Mais lorsqu'elle devient accidentellement virale pour avoir détruit un nouveau restaurant, son rédacteur insiste pour qu'elle fasse amende honorable en se cachant en tant que cuisinière pour le chef qu'elle a calomnié.

programme.title: Le gala de l'amour
programme.desc: Katie, organisatrice d'événements talentueuse, doit gérer le prestigieux Garden Gala de sa mère. Entre un paysagiste difficile et la pression familiale, elle se retrouve plongée dans un inattendu triangle amoureux.

programme.title: Flirt et passe-passe
programme.desc: Lors d'un séjour à Trinité-et-Tobago, deux jumelles identiques sont prises l'une pour l'autre par leurs prétendants respectifs. En jouant le jeu, elles découvrent que l'amour pourrait les mener là où elles ne l'attendaient pas.

programme.title: L'amour dans l'oreillette
programme.desc: Sam, coach en amour réputée à Los Angeles, guide ses clients pendant leurs rendez-vous. Mais lorsque Mattie remet en cause ses méthodes, Sam découvre que le véritable amour ne suit peut-être aucune règle.

programme.title: Here Today (2021)
programme.desc: Charlie Burnz (Billy Crystal), un écrivain connu pour ses comédies hilarantes, se lie d'amitié avec une chanteuse de rue new-yorkaise Emma Payge (Tiffany Haddish). Emma gagne de manière inattendue un déjeuner avec la légende de la comédie et leur amitié prend un départ extrêmement difficile (pensez à une allergie aux fruits de mer, à une visite à l'hôpital et à un auto-injecteur d'épinéphrine). Il s'est passé beaucoup de choses avant que chacun trouve dans l'autre une sorte d'âme sœur, forgeant un lien profond qui met de côté le fossé générationnel et redéfinit le sens de l'amitié, de l'amour et de la confiance.

programme.title: On arrête quand ?
programme.desc: Are We Done Yet? est la suite de la comédie familiale hilarante de Revolution Studios, Are We There Yet? (2005) et reprend l'histoire là où elle s'était arrêtée. Nick Persons (Ice Cube), dorénavant marié à Suzanne (Nia Long), vient d'acheter une maison dans un quartier de banlieue paisible pour échapper au chaos de la ville et fournir plus d'espace à sa nouvelle femme et ses enfants, Lindsey et Kevin (Aleisha Allen et Philip Daniel Bolden). Mais lorsque les réparations de sa nouvelle maison commencent vite à lui coûter plus que prévu et qu'il se retrouve à la merci d'un entrepreneur en bâtiment excentrique (John C. McGinley), le rêve suburbain de Nick se transforme vite en cauchemar.

programme.title: Animal L'animal
programme.desc: Marvin est un véritable loser et le bouc émissaire de ses collègues policiers. Après avoir été victime d'un terrible accident de voiture, il est soigné par un savant qui lui greffe des organes d'animaux : si cela lui permet de sentir la drogue et de sauver le fils du maire de la noyade, il lui est de plus en plus difficile de se contrôler.

programme.title: Are We There Yet?
programme.desc: Nick rêve d'un rendez-vous avec Suzanne, mais elle ne souhaite que son amitié. Lorsqu'elle se trouve coincée à cause de son travail, il lui propose de lui amener ses enfants à Vancouver pour le réveillon. Mais pour eux, aucun homme n'est assez bien pour leur mère, et ils sont capables de tout.

programme.title: Les Trois Implacables

Le sculpteur Démétrius, chargé de réaliser le visage de la déesse Diane, tombe amoureux d'une esclave, la chrétienne Lerna. Avec l'arrivée de la peste, le mécontentement du peuple grandit et Antigonus accuse facilement les chrétiens, qui sont immédiatement arrêtés et condamnés à mort. Les troupes romaines arrivent pour rétablir l'ordre, sauvant les deux amants Démétrius et Lerna.

programme.desc: Sonia Choquette, a spiritual teacher and intuitive guide, explains how to tune into and trust your intuition, which opens you up to a more fun, loving, and spontaneous life. Your spirit is fully equipped to take care of you. Your brain and your body might struggle, but your sixth sense – your spirit, your intuition – can take care of you no matter what.

programme.title: Poppy Jamie: There's No Such Thing As Coincidence
programme.desc: Entrepreneur and author Poppy Jamie discusses intuition, coincidence, and inner wisdom with Fearne Cotton. They explore why collective exhaustion stems from trusting logic over gut instinct, and how inexplicable moments expand our understanding of what's possible. Poppy shares her near-infertility diagnosis and how belief in magic, intuition, and the support of wise women have helped her cope.

programme.title: Perrie Edwards On The Cost Of Fame
programme.desc: A panic attack can feel like you're dying from a heart attack this is something former Little Mix member Perrie Edwards has experienced numerous times over the last few years. Perrie talks about how her anxiety feels like her adult is 'going offline', leaving the child in her crying for help.

programme.title: Michelle Keegan On Imposter Syndrome, Boundaries, And Puzzles
programme.desc: Imposter syndrome is likely to affect all of us at some point in our life Michelle Keegan still feels it every time she finishes an acting job. In this chat with Fearne, Michelle talks about her disciplined work ethic, as well as how she's learnt to cope well with the amount of rejection in her industry. They also chat about why setting boundaries – especially drawing lines between personal and professional life – is so important. Plus, they wonder why it still feels important in adulthood to seek validation from our parents.

programme.title: Monty Don: Why Doing Nothing Isn't How He Switches Off
programme.desc: What does a truly restful holiday look like? Horticulturalist Monty Don relaxes most when he knows the drill: same Greek island, same terrace for breakfast, same collapsible travel kettle packed. In this chat with Fearne, Monty explains the difference between all the globe-trotting he does for work and a proper switching-off holiday. They discuss the excitement of stepping off a plane into an entirely different culture, as well as why you won't find either of them staying up late for a social dinner.

programme.title: Miquita Oliver: "I Thought I Hated You Fearne"
programme.desc: Back in the noughties, Miquita Oliver thought Fearne Cotton was an irritatingly gorgeous, successful presenter - everything she wasn't. Fearne was jealous Miquita was part of the TV cool gang. In reality, Fearne worried she was an unsophisticated nerd, while Miquita was feeling like the fat, ugly sidekick. Live from the Happy Place Festival.

programme.title: Matt Edmondson & Mollie King On Imposter Syndrome & Finding Your Voice
programme.desc: Fearne Cotton talks with Radio 1 presenters Matt Edmondson and Mollie King about self-doubt, imposter syndrome, and the power of supportive friendships. From Mollie's memories of struggling to read out loud at school to Matt's experience of feeling like an imposter when he first joined Radio 1, they explore the inner critic so many of us live with.

programme.title: Julian Clary On Easing Anxiety
programme.desc: Can laughter ease anxiety? Comedian Julian Clary certainly thinks so. After living some incredibly dark events and anxious times, he's decided to choose to laugh and think positive thoughts. In this chat with Fearne, Julian talks about feeling naturally happier and more comfortable in his skin as he got older. Most things, he says, just aren't as important as you think they are, and that's a freeing realisation.

programme.title: How Oligarchs Control Democracy
programme.desc: Jeffrey Winters, a political scientist at Northwestern University, explores how oligarchs turn wealth into political power. Winters challenges conventional thinking about power, arguing that oligarchs aren't just corrupt billionaires in distant countries but individuals whose vast wealth gives them influence far beyond ordinary citizens. They operate within democratic systems, not outside them.

programme.title: How America's Military Was Taken Over By White Supremacists
programme.desc: Matt Kennard discusses his book Irregular Army: How the US Military Recruited Neo-Nazis, Gang Members and Criminals. Kennard details how, as the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan dragged on, the Bush administration faced a recruitment crisis. Rather than reintroducing the draft, it loosened enlistment standards, opening the door to recruits who would previously have been barred from service.

programme.title: How AI Will Destroy Democracy
programme.desc: Daron Acemoglu, a Nobel Prize-winning economist and author of What Happened to Liberal Democracy, discusses why liberal democracy is facing one of its biggest crises in generations. Acemoglu argues that the problems facing democracies go much deeper than individual politicians. Across the UK, US and Europe, trust in political institutions has eroded as economic growth has become less widely shared, communities have weakened and the relationship between political elites and working-class voters has fractured.

programme.title: Holocaust Survivor Eviscerates The Far-Right

The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Cheong Ja decides to return to acting, hoping to restore her former glory and figure out what happened to her. She's assisted by Dokgo Cheol (Song Seung Heon), a former violent crimes detective who got demoted to traffic duty... and who shares a mysterious past connection with Se Ra. To both Cheong Ja and Cheol's surprise, they begin to fall for each other, sending their lives onto an entirely new trajectory.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard

Trapped in the shallows, the rays breach the surface and swim for their lives, as the Orca pursue – with a highly evolved practice for avoiding the rays' stinging tail. programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: A few thousand years ago, there were bare moraine ridges and barren meltwater valleys here. A landscape born in the last ice age, characterized by the edge of the Alps, gentle hills, moors, and lakes. And by cultural richness, not only on the islands in Lake Chiemsee, with their famous monasteries and castles. Long before King Ludwig II, the first people settled in the Chiemgau region. Finds of hunting weapons from the Neanderthal era prove that the land was inhabited even during the ice age, probably because there was plenty of game to hunt. During the Bronze Age, one of the most important trade routes from the mountains to the Alpine foothills passed through here. Then came the Celts and the Romans.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: Three times in the past two decades, the Chiemsee area has experienced "once-in-a-century" floods. Climate, wildlife, and landscape have changed, and it seems this transformation is accelerating. Species living in the flood zones are developing sophisticated survival strategies. Knot ants, for instance, place their queen in the middle and form a raft with their bodies, even conquering new habitats. Flooding is less of a disaster for nature and impacts humans more significantly.

programme.title: Bavarian Forest
programme.desc: After an unusual mass reproduction of bark beetles in the nineties, thousands hectares of old spruce forest were destroyed. Soon after, a new, healthier forest started to grow – a new primeval forest. Within a few years, in place of the former monoculture, a diverse forest developed, rich in spruces, ashes, beech and fir trees. Naturally, this diversity has in turn attracted new animal and plant species. Even lynx and otters returned and made Bavaria their home again.

programme.title: mareTV
programme.desc: Sweden's Höga Kusten (High Coast) has been rising by almost one centimetre per year since the last ice age 10,000 years ago. This has created a hilly Baltic Sea landscape on the Gulf of Bothnia with small and large islands. Untouched nature, dense forests and energetic, rather idiosyncratic islanders have plenty of room there. Every year at the end of August a biting stench mixes with the fresh Baltic Sea breeze. For weeks the so-called sour herring, Swedish: Surströmming, is fermented in brine. Ruben Madsen is a producer of surströmming and an absolute connoisseur. In his wooden hut on the island of Ulvön he puts the herring in according to a traditional recipe. At the start of the season, the cans are opened for the first time. Lovers of the "stinky fish" then come from all over the world to taste the now world-famous delicacy in cans. Opening the cans of "rotten fish" is considered internationally as a test of courage, people film themselves doing so, the inhabitants of the High Coast can only smile about it.

programme.title: Turkey
programme.desc: The 1st episode of the ARTE series "Adventure Turkey" shows the Mediterranean region: blossoming orchards, olive groves and "still" untouched nature frame historical treasures. In this environment, tradition and modernity engage in a daily confrontation. Is it better to preserve old craft traditions? Can they be brought into the modern age? Sabine Howe meets women who are swimming free, men who are clinging on - but above all people who are trying anew every day to resolve this question for themselves.

programme.title: Turkey
programme.desc: The 2nd episode starts in Central Anatolia, goes through Cappadocia and ends near the Syrian border. Those who set off from Antalya on the coast inland will reach Isparta. In the rose-growing region, author Nadja Frenz is intoxicated by the intense scent of the Damascene rose, in Konya she meets the dancing Dervishes and discovers the fairytale landscape of Cappadocia. The journey ends with homemade liqueurs in Samandağ, where Christians, Jews, Alewites and Sunnis still live in peaceful harmony - just a few kilometers from the Syrian border.

programme.title: Turkey
programme.desc: In episode 3, the journey goes to the almost forgotten region of Eastern Anatolia, which borders Armenia, Iran, Iraq and Syria. Accordingly, different cultures and religions mix here. The landscape is characterized by magnificent mountain ranges and endless steppes. Most people here live very simply, with sheep and goats adapted to the barren conditions and dry climate. The predominantly Kurdish society is still traditionally organized, with clear roles for women and men.

programme.title: Turkey
programme.desc: The 4th episode takes us along the Black Sea coast. Author Claudia Wallbrecht uncovers the secret of the Tulum, a very special type of bagpipe, and accompanies a forest beekeeper on breakneck climbing adventures in the name of honey. The eastern Black Sea region borders on Georgia and Armenia, and here cultures, languages and ethnic groups have been mixing for centuries: for example, Hemşin, Lasen and the descendants of Pontic Greeks. They all shape the region - and this episode - with their music, architecture, food and ancient customs.

programme.title: Turkey
programme.desc: The 5th part of "Adventure Turkey" throws itself into the middle of the hustle and bustle of Istanbul! Against the backdrop of the Golden Horn and the Bosphorus, the Arte team experiences lonely hearts in search of connection, spraying artists who make the city more colorful, calligraphers who preserve the old. They meet modern women with creative minds and conservative women with creative minds, fathom coffee law reading and get intoxicated by Fasil singing.

programme.title: The Black Sea Coast
programme.desc: This coast offers everything: golden sandy beaches in the south, a spectacular water labyrinth in the north. Romania and Bulgaria on the Black Sea: that is a mixture of centuries-old traditions, Eastern Bloc charm and modern Europe. Meet the people who give the region an unique face: horse rescuers, castle owners, shellfish breeders.

Strawberry is touched by their surprise, but reminds them that now the town and Marketplace really have to shine!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Cherry Jam is so enjoying staying in Berry Bitty City, that she calls her managers in Big Bitty City and informs them that she is going to stay for a much needed vacation! But Cherry doesn't want to be treated like a guest she wants to fit in and contribute to the community.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Berry Bitty City is holding its first city-wide talent show! Hearing that it's the music students of superstar Cherry Jam, a talent scout from Big Bitty City plans to show up. Strawberry and her friends excitedly anticipate her arrival.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Raspberry is discovered by a talent scout who wants her to move to Berry Big City and design a new line of Glitter fashions! She will be provided with her own studio, staff, publicity, commitments from big department stores-everything she needs to be a big fashion designing star! All her friends are thrilled for her. Only Cherry is a bit less enthusiastic about Raspberry's stardom, which Raspberry mistakenly interprets as jealousy.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With the summer almost over, Blueberry overhears Strawberry talking about a wonderful tropical island and believes her friend is going to surprise them all with a much needed vacation! Blueberry makes the other girls promise to keep the secret until Strawberry reveals the big surprise. Of course, even though they've promised to keep the secret, they can't help but try and suss out what the island's like from every little thing Strawberry does.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It's the last week of summer and Berry Bitty City is hopping with activity as the girls prepare for their tropical island vacation at Berry Breezy Bay Resort. But just as they're about to leave, bad news: the resort is closed for the season due to berry breezy weather. The girls are disappointed, but Orange isn't giving up. She says if they can't go to the tropical island, maybe they can bring the tropical island here!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With only a few days of summer left, the girls are about to enjoy their first vacation in their newly-created, tropical beach resort at Berry Bitty Lake, when who should descend upon them but Mavis Maraschino, the comically over-the-top "Entertainment Tonight"-style show host. Mavis has dumped her focus on fashions in favor of an even glitzier show called Lifestyles of the Berry Big Bitty Stars, and she wants her first segment to be about how pop superstar Cherry Jam spends her vacation.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: On a beautiful winter's night, Blueberry reads the Baby Berrykins a story of what happened one winter in Berry Bitty City-a winter that almost wasn't. Just as everyone is ready for winter fun and fashions, a sudden warming melts the snow and ruins their plans. Improvising with snowmen made of shaved ice and cotton puffs, Strawberry and her friends play "Capture the Snowman's Carrot Nose." The Berrykins want to join in the fun, so the girls play against them, with Strawberry refereeing.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It's another windy winter day, and the postal bees are staying indoors-the wind is too strong for their berry bitty wings. "We don't know when the next mail will get through!" It's bad news for Blueberry, who has been anxiously awaiting the next installment of a Patty Persimmon Detective story. If only she could get to the post office in Berry Bitty Dale where her package is waiting!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: It appears winter is finally coming to an end and Raspberry is planning a big fashion show to display her spring line. Every time the girls come to rehearse, they must comically dodge jets of fruit juice from the out-of-control fountain-the Berrykins are still working out the bugs.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry, Cherry and the girls form a new band, Strawberry and the Sweet Beats, and prepare to go on the road to perform at the Opening Ceremony of the Berry Big City Games! While master mechanic Berrykin Bruce turns Cherry's tour bus into the band's hotel-on-wheels, Strawberry and her friends pack for the big trip. But the rest of Berry Bitty City points out that someone needs to run the girls' businesses while they are gone.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: Stiix and Stones
programme.desc: The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply so the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks – and when they fail to make enough cash, the Ninja decide to steal it – but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but when the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply, the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks. Meanwhile, reluctant to give up being Samurai X, Nya struggles to embrace being a Water Ninja, and Sensei Wu gives her a riddle to figure out. Back at Stiix, when the Ninja fail to make enough cash working the docks, the Ninja decide to steal it... but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. After Moro gets away with the scroll, the Ninja are left dangling, but Ronan saves them at a price – for a piece of their share in the Tea Farm.

programme.title: Public Enemy Number One
programme.desc: The Ninja must find out as much as they can about Nadakhan before he finds the Realm Crystal to save his crew, but after the Ninja are labeled enemies by the world they used to protect, our heroes find themselves hunted by their old friend, Ronan. With the Destiny's Bounty impounded, the police hire Ronin to track down the fugitive ninja. Misako has been arrested and is confronted by Nadakhan, who reveals he has trapped Wu in the Teapot of Tyrahn. Misako accidentally reveals the location of the Realm Crystal. The ninja discover that Wu was researching djinn when he disappeared and split up to learn more about their potential new foe. Lloyd and Zane head to the Library of Domu. While there, Ronin hacks into Zane's systems and shuts him down, then captures Lloyd. Ronin uses Zane's SOS beacon to lure Kai and Nya into the desert, where they are captured. Later, Cole and Jay are defeated by Ronin as well. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has used his powers to foil the high-tech security guarding the Realm Crystal and steals it. The ninja are hauled off to Kryptarium Prison and Nadakhan is free to gather his lost crew.

programme.title: Enkrypted
programme.desc: The secret, he says, is the venom of a Tiger Widow, a rare creature that lives on only one island. The venom can slow a djinn down. Soto is the only one who knows where the island is and will only tell if the ninja break him out of jail. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has decided to return to his home realm of Djinjago, only to discover it is falling apart. The ninja's destruction of the Cursed Realm is affecting the realms connected to it. Nadakhan uses the Djinn Blade to smash the Teapot, absorbing all the spirits that were trapped there into the sword. Falsely imprisoned, the Ninja are at their lowest point, but find an unlikely friend in an old enemy. Meanwhile, Nadakhan rescues his marooned crew and gains a new perspective, along with a new mysterious plan. With the ninja imprisoned, Nadakhan uses the Realm Crystal to free his old crew. The ninja encounter Captain Soto, the first captain of the Destiny's Bounty, who tells them the story of how he originally trapped Nadakhan in the Teapot. Nadakhan vows revenge on the ninja and NINJAGO. The ninja and Soto escape from jail, only to find out the map to the island is on Nadakhan's ship. Nadakhan discovers that Nya looks just like Delara, his long-lost love.

programme.title: Misfortune Rising
programme.desc: The Ninja are on a collision course to find the map to stop Nadakhan, they first must find him. Meanwhile, Jay makes a wish to change his future, but it could alter his past indefinitely. The ninja's search for Nadakhan's ship turns up nothing. Nadakhan's crew is struggling to handle an airship which used to sail only on the oceans. Nadakhan confronts Jay and talks him into making a wish that will win him Nya. Jay wishes that he wasn't born in a junkyard and was rich. The next moment, he receives a letter saying his father has died and he has inherited his estate. Jay rushes home to find his parents in the junkyard and finds out they are fine, but they reveal that he is adopted. Jay discovers that his real father is the actor who played his favorite movie hero. In an effort to trap the ninja, the Sky Pirates start raids all over NINJAGO City. Nadakhan kidnaps Kai, who makes two wishes, both of which go wrong. His third wish is to “make it all go away.” Nadakhan's first mate, Flintlocke, accidentally destroys the Realm Crystal and Cole steals Soto's map. The Destiny's Bounty mysteriously vanishes from the police impound yard.

programme.title: The Cloud
programme.desc: A storm is brewing over Knighton. Monstrox has taken the form of a cloud, and is raising an army of lightning infused Stone Monsters. His first target is the new Lavalands Amusement Park. Harmony reigns in Knighton as the Knights pursue their civilian lives: Lance has a TV talk show Axl is the singing chef on the show Jestro is the weatherman Clay is teaching at the Knights' Academy Macy, Ava and Merlok 2.0 travel the land in the Fortrex making sure the kingdom's defenses are ready (part of a plan she and Clay have) Aaron and his hover shield is travelling the land setting extreme records. Robin is at his workshop at the Knights' Academy doing an “independent study” – he's working on some top secret project for Merlok 2.0. It all seems excellent! We even see the Knights new vehicles – which have been optimized for civilian life (except for Clay's.) But storm clouds are brewing. Well, one storm cloud is brewing: the Cloud of Monstrox! Yes, the Book of Monsters has reconstituted himself and is now a cloud who needs a man on the ground to enact his new evil plan. He follows his old buddy Jestro as he goes across the realm on the weekends apologizing for being evil. ZAP! With one bolt of his evil magic lighting, the Cloud of Monstrox turns Jestro evil again (only this time a bit, well, too evil.) The evil duo are back together – and bring stone to life for the first time in the form of Gargoyles from the town of GHOULIA. Now they must gather the Forbidden Powers so that the Cloud of Monstrox can destroy the entire kingdom! A battle breaks out in the Lava Lands, where Lance and Alice Squires are reporting from the opening of the Cuthbert Richmond funded Lava Lands Amusement Park, rebuilt from the remains of Jestro's old HQ. Jestro and the Cloud are after something in the remains and as Merlok 2.0 sends out a call for the Knights to help Lance. Can Lance (with an assist from King Halbert in his Mech) hold-off Jestro, the Cloud and their new army of stone fighters?!

programme.title: A Little Rusty
programme.desc: The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro unlocks a mysterious Forbidden Power. What kind ofhavoc will they unleash? And can Merlok 2.0 and the NEXO KNIGHTS make the new COMBO NEXO Powers work? The Knights finally make it to the Lava Lands – using their various new forms of transport, which are all strictly civilian vechicles – and they must regroup and learn to fight together again to face the new threat of Jestro, the Cloud of Monstrox, and their STONE MONSTERS (in this case, Stone Gargoyles.) But Jestro and his monsters beat back the knights and recover the STAFF OF MONSTROX – which was buried under the ceremonial chamber from Episode 210 (and is now the Lava Puker amusement park ride) – and they get away on Jestro's EVIL MOBILE, which he recovers from the HQ garage. Macy says this is exactly why she's been touring the kingdom preparing everyone for the next attack. The Knights have to get it together because now the entire kingdom is under threat…again. Robin decides he must upgrade the Knights' vehicles and make them more “fight optimized.” Ava and Merlok 2.0 must figure out how to use new NEXO Powers because regular NEXO Powers do make Stone monsters back into stone, but the Cloud simply zaps them to life again. Meanwhile, in the IRON MOUNTAINS, Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox find the first of the Forbidden Powers: RELENTLESS RUST. They find the ROGUL STATUE holding the power and zap him to life. Now…they can rust those shiny knights to pieces! Ava and Merlok are attempting to use NEXO COMBO POWERS – with hilarious results – as they try to figure out how they might work. When Jestro attacks, he's able to halt the Fortrex by instantly rusting its tracks and wheels! Robin has his hands full trying to clean all the rust from the attack of Relentless Rust. As the Knights attempt to defend against Jestro, the Cloud is zapping statues to life. He hits a statue with a bolt of lightning as Clay is touching it. Something happens…Clay feels odd stiff as if rock is mixing with his body. Finally, Ava and Merlok 2.0 download to the Knights their new thing: a COMBO NEXO COMBO Power. It works! It can smash the animated statues to dust! They use it to defeat Jestro, but he and the Cloud get away with the Forbidden Power of Relentless Rust. Victory … sort of. Clay talks to Merlok 2.0…something has happened to him. What can they do? Merlok 2.0 is very concerned.

programme.title: Thunderstox
programme.desc: Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox encounters the sculptor. He helps unleash a horde of fierce garden gnomes on Knighton. What will the NEXO KNIGHTS do against this new enemy? Will their new COMBO NEXO Powers do the trick? As Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox head off on the Evil Mobile to 'store' the Forbidden Power in a secret location, they encounter…THE SCULPTOR. His real name is ROBERTO ARNOLDI. He's a sensitive and odd artist who has been laid off by the king (the King ordered a "smashing" statue of the Queen, and the Sculptor made a statue of the Queen literally smashing monsters. He takes everything very literally.) Jestro instructs him to make a "bad" statue that he can use to attack the knights. The Sculptor sets to work. Meanwhile, the NEXO KNIGHTS are discussing the COMBO NEXO Powers, the Forbidden Powers, and what all this means. Lance, meanwhile, decides that since his talk show career is on hold, he thinks he'll install cameras in the Fortrex and do a Big Brother-like expose show on the Knights (he decides NOT to tell the others.) Merlok 2.0 and the Cloud of Monstrox (each talking to their cohorts) explain the history of the Forbidden Powers: it's a history lesson about the WIZARDS' COUNCIL, the Forbidden Powers, and how they were stopped long ago. This visual montage leads Jestro to…MOUNT THUNDERSTROX. The Cloud of Monstrox shows him the circle of ten Standing Stones where he will insert the Forbidden Powers. "What'll happen after that?” asks Jestro, curious. "Oh, I don't want to spoil the surprise," says the Cloud. They insert the first Forbidden Power, Relentless Rust, and it locks into place on its stone. They go off to battle the Knights and collect the "bad" statue the sculptor is making. But he's made a literally bad statue…it's terrible ... garden gnomes. Like an amateur art student. And…it's not even finished. ("You can't rush bad genius!") The Knights attack with their newly modified vehicles and they succeed in destroying the Evil Mobile. They then try to use a COMBO NEXO Power, but can't…it had to be perfect to work (Ava and Merlok need to work on it.) As Jestro and the Cloud retreat, Merlok again talks to Clay about turning to stone! Merlok calls in Robin…he will need him to build something to help Clay as he becomes more and more impaired.

programme.title: Weekend At Halberts
programme.desc: Party time in Knighton! The mood is down so the King decides to throw a party. In the meantime Jestro attacks the Fortrex, but he is confronted with the new NEXO Power "The Wedgie of Doom". Clay is turned to stone and everyone is gloomy. Especially King Halbert. In order to get everything in a better mood Aaron organizes a celebration. The King wants a reenactment of Clay's heroic rescue of the Queen. He is (as usual) totally unaware of Clay's situation. In order not to disappoint him further, the Knights get a remote control for Clay's Battle suit and is thus able to “perform” as Clay. Lance is happy to exercise his acting abilities and quickly gets into the role of the uptight knight of knights. Ava is working on reinstalling Merlok 2.0 into the Fortrex with Robin. She is also preparing the Fortrex for a visit from the new Knights' Academy novices. It is a fieldtrip with Principal Brickland and Sir Griffiths with the goal of teaching the kids about these new so-called High-tech battle strategies. Not really feeling it for anything modern, it quickly turns into a regular trip back memory lane for Brickland and Sir Griffiths. This out of control excursion is an excellent moment for Jestro who is looking for an opportunity to cheer up the defeated Monstrox. Unfortunately, for Jestro, Ava is able to make Merlok 2.0 functional again, and the Novices are able to fight Jestro and his monsters off using the NEXO Power: Wedgie of Doom. It is a humiliating defeat. Apparently, this is just what the doctor ordered for Monstrox. A good laugh at someone else's expense. His evil mood is back on.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Masha tells her version of the fairy tale about the poor girl called Cinderella. She lived with her stepmother who forced her to work till dawn. One day the stepmother asked Cinderella to crack three bags of nuts. The poor girl would never have managed to complete this task, if only the fairy had appeared in front of her. By magic, the fairy emerged and conjured her Nutcracker, who helped Cinderella to crack all the nuts very fast. The Cinderella was so happy that she took the Nutcracker with her to the ball, which took place in the royal palace. The Nutcracker helped the King to save the palace from rats and Cinderella was so thankful that she kissed him in his cheek. In this very moment the Nutcracker turned into a handsome prince! The moral of the story is that we should not judge the others by their appearance.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: CRIME FILES

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter Kim Jae-hyung! Kim Jae-hyung is a self-taught guitarist who picked up the guitar when he was serving in the NAVY as a secretary for the naval military band. He continued playing the instrument after his discharge and had the first public performance in 2013 at an unplugged open mic night. Then in 2017 he released his first EP CIRCUS. Three years later he presented his first full-length album Flex which was nominated for Best Folk Album at the 2021 Korean Music Awards and the lead single Failure Story was nominated for Best Folk Song. Kim Jae-hyung is also known for covering a wide spectrum of music. Recently he came up with a new single titled Addiction with danceable vibes. Constantly pushing his musical boundaries this artist definitely makes us look forward to his future moves. In this episode Kim Jae-hyung performs Addiction Failure Story More Doubt and more. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is a singer who just wants to present good music - J_ust! J_ust made his debut in 2015 with the mini-album #DearMuse #201507_08 #PinkRibbon. Known for his heartfelt lyrics and sounds he comforts numerous listeners at the end of a tough day. Thanks to that magical power Jeong Eun-ji from Apink released a remake of his song How's your night for the soundtrack of She's My Type and his song Way Back Home was featured in the ending of JTBC Newsroom. In this episode J_ust performs How's your night Way Back Home I wanna go out Actually I like you and will be happy to console everyone's heart. Tune in to I'm LIVE and enjoy all the heartwarming songs he has to comfort you!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is electronic musician and producer YESEO! This artist burst into the music scene in 2016 with her first single Let It All Go. Two years later in 2018 she was nominated for Best Rookie Best Dance & Electronic Album Best Dance & Electronic Song at the 15th Korean Music Awards with her first EP Million Things. This talented musician mesmerized not only domestic listeners but those outside Korea. The UK's Noisey highlighted YESEO as one of the most ambitious young guns in Seoul and she even opened for Cherokee and Honne during their concerts in Seoul. In this episode YESEO performs Privacy HOT HAND Cigarette Light as well as Youthful Kids and Free Up from her latest EP TRY TREE! Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter YEGNY formerly known as Choi Ye-geun! This artist first became known in 2012 as the genius keyboardist in an audition program titled K-pop Star - Season 2. Since then she has actively pursued her career as a musician releasing a number of singles and working with other top-notch musicians including AKMU. Last year YEGNY released her first full-length album Even If Get Lost It Can Flow Anyway and shared with the public her concerns as a musician and self-reflection as well as her view on human relationships and social issues. With the song Better Rush (feat. Huckleberry P) she changed her stage name to YEGNY to mark a new beginning as an artist. In this episode YEGNY performs Better Rush I know Lucid dream and Unbalance as well as her cover of Better by BoA and Irony by Wonder Girls. Tune in to I'm LIVE and check out all that YEGNY has to show off!

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.desc: The new GLC is immediately recognisable as a member of the Mercedes-Benz SUV family. Standard equipment includes the AVANTGARDE exterior with Chrome package including chrome window surrounds and a new, chrome-look simulated underguard. This adds striking design features and enhances the unique proportions of the vehicle. One of the defining design highlights of the GLC is the redesigned front end, with headlamps that connect directly to the radiator grille to emphasise the vehicle's width, and the new radiator grille as part of the standard AVANTGARDE exterior, which now has a chrome surround and a sporty louvre in matt grey with chrome trim. The AMG Line has a radiator grille with Mercedes-Benz pattern. The body design is characterised by a full, spanned surface design enriched with precisely shaped edges in the sides. These emphasise the proportions, accentuate the muscular wheel arches and create a balance between elegance and off-road performance. Wheel arch liners in the vehicle colour are available from the AMG Line upwards for the first time. These accentuate the sportiness of the AMG Line, as optional equipment in conjunction with mixed tyres. Also available as an optional extra are easy-entry running boards and, from the AMG Line upwards, a Night package.

programme.desc: With the luxury saloon EQS and the sporty executive saloon EQE, Mercedes-Benz has entered a new, all-electric era in the upper market segments as well. The SUV offers plenty of space, comfort and connectivity for up to seven passengers in its avant-garde, luxurious interior. Thanks to powerful electric motors, responsive 4MATIC all-wheel drive and an intelligent OFFROAD driving mode, the EQS SUV is also capable of tackling light terrain with ease. The new EQS SUV shares the long wheelbase (3210 millimetres) with the EQS Saloon, but is over 20 centimetres higher. The dimensions in detail: 5125/1959/1718 millimetres (length/width/height). programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.desc: The turbocharged three-litre flat-six in the new 911 GTS delivers 353 kW (480 PS). Maximum torque is 570 Nm, an increase of 20 Nm over its predecessor. Zero to 100 km/h takes just 3.3 seconds (911 Carrera 4 GTS: Fuel consumption combined (NEDC) 10.5 – 9.7 l/100 km, Fuel consumption combined (WLTP) 11.4 – 10.6 l/100 km, CO₂ emissions combined (NEDC) 240 – 222 g/km, CO₂ emissions combined (WLTP) 259 – 240 g/km) in the 911 Carrera 4 GTS Coupé with the eight-speed Porsche dual-clutch transmission (PDK): three tenths faster than its predecessor. programme.title: From concept vehicle to full-production ID. Buzz
programme.sub-title: How was the electric Microbus created
programme.desc: The new model line's assistance systems perfect ease of driving and safety. Included as standard in the ID. Buzz and ID. Buzz Cargo is the ‘Car2X' local warning system, which utilises signals from other vehicles and the transport infrastructure to spot hazards in real time. Also included as standard: the ‘Front Assist' emergency braking function and, in the MPV, the ‘Lane Assist' lane-keeping assistant. With new software, new assistance functions are also making their way into the ID. family. Available as an option is ‘Travel Assist with swarm data', which facilitates partially automated driving across the entire speed range and, for the first time, assisted lane-changing on the motorway. Also new: the ‘Memory Function' for automated parking on a previously saved route.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.
